Good evening, As AI continues to infiltrate college campuses and the workplace, students may wonder: Is a college degree really worth it? And which schools are most likely to produce a good return on a student’s investment of time and tuition? Here's our list of colleges and universities with the highest return on investment for a relatively low price. Forbes’ Top 50 Small Colleges: These private schools deliver great outcomes and unusually close access to professors, but high prices are putting some small colleges at risk. Forbes’ Top 25 Public Colleges: These universities produce strong academic and career outcomes while charging state residents far lower tuition than their private counterparts. When choosing a school amid the AI age, it still comes down to academic fit, cost and career payoff—but families should also consider how colleges are preparing students for the future. Thanks for reading! Hello from the FT newsroom, where we have been paying a lot of attention to a German state of just 2.1mn people. On Sunday Saxony-Anhalt catapulted the far-right party Alternative for Germany (AfD) to its best-ever election result, with 44 per cent of the vote. Ulrich Siegmund, whose inner circle includes at least two former members of neo-Nazi youth groups, could soon lead the most rightwing government to run a German state since the Third Reich. But what can the AfD’s victory in a small, relatively poor and elderly part of Germany’s former communist east tell us about the country writ large? Worryingly, quite a lot — as our reporters explain in this piece. Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who is about as popular as Keir Starmer was before he resigned as British prime minister, is running out of time to prove the political centre can still deliver. My choices this week US President Donald Trump wants to build a missile shield stretching from Earth into space in order to protect America from foreign missile attacks. But formidable engineering, financial and political obstacles stand in the way. This visual investigation uncovers the holes in Trump’s Golden Dome plan — and the companies cashing in on it. Our reporters reveal that Anthropic declined to submit its latest model to Britain’s AI Security Institute for testing before release. The decision has prompted fears inside the UK government that tech companies are falling into line with the Trump administration’s AI protectionism. (Free to read) For years Iran has imposed onerous hurdles on importers and exporters to control the supply of foreign currency. But according to Iranian businesses and regime insiders, Tehran has in recent months encouraged traders to repatriate funds by whatever means necessary — including via cryptocurrencies. What makes a great chief executive? Some will point to workforce sentiment, others to shareholder returns. But no single measure truly captures the role. Our new CEO Performance Ranking allows you to remix the data to find your own top-performing business leader from across the FTSE 100. Was Jesus anti-capitalist? If he were alive today, where would he sit on the political and economic spectrum? Find out on the latest episode of our video podcast series The Story of Money.
